reason_for_v6.controlled_diagnosis: Every v5 swing reversal in reserve-2 failed while the past 240-minute median trade-index basis remained negative. The same state was positive in reserve-1. The correction is a causal regime branch, not a loss-specific filter.
reason_for_v6.v4_and_v5_history: freeze-v4-invalidated.md and the v5 evidence remain immutable; v6 treats reserve-1 and reserve-2 as development after the reserve-2 failure was opened.

causal_state_machine.regime: past 240-minute median trade-index basis; non-negative is normal, negative is persistent perpetual discount/deleveraging stress
normal: SWING_FAILED_AUCTION_RESUMPTION from the frozen v5 swing-pool state machine
INVENTORY_BACKED_DISPLACEMENT from the frozen v5 directional inventory state
stress: Treat that reversal as a competing-risk probe: its all-cost hypothetical target means rejection succeeded; a close beyond the original sweep extreme first means price acceptance and triggers STRESS_REVERSAL_FAILURE_CONTINUATION on the next minute.

STRESS_INVENTORY_SHOCK_DISPLACEMENT requires raw 15-minute OI growth and 60-second executed-notional burst to exceed their shifted, past-only rolling 95th-percentile thresholds, plus the existing displacement, flow, absorption and low-efficiency state.
causal_state_machine.global: At most one entry intent or one open position. Same-side intents within five minutes are one parent event.

execution_and_risk.entry: following one-minute open after every required observation

limited_neighbourhood_check.result: Every listed one-variable perturbation kept both development weeks above 1% all-cost geometric daily growth. The strict 97.5th-percentile shock setting retained seven trades, six wins and 1.77% daily geometric growth in the stress week.
